Synopsis:
Mol the kid leader is standing on the beach far enough from the bulk of the festivities.

Cluster Contexts:
- CAMP_GoblinHuntCelebration_KidLeader.json: Mol is a precocious, early-teen tiefling who runs a Den gang of thieving kids and has already had off-screen encounters with the player — sometimes helpful, sometimes hostile. In this beach scene she’s meeting the player apart from the festivities to confront them about an idol and a prior bargain (or about stolen goods her crew may have taken). The excerpts show the player lying about the idol; Mol sees through the lie and responds with disappointment, authority, and an implied threat to cut the deal. Her attitude here is shaped by how the player treated her kids earlier — she can shift between friendly, pragmatic, or openly hostile and may return items, scatter the gang, or escalate to guards if provoked.
- DEN_Thieflings_AD_HideoutTrespass.json: Mol is an early-teen tiefling who runs the Den’s band of thieving kids and is fiercely protective of them. In this scene the player has been caught inside her hideout; Mol is serious and threatening, counting down and shouting for the kids to scatter, even threatening to tell the guards. Her attitude here is shaped by off-screen choices — you may previously have fought, parleyed, struck bargains (she has dealt with outsiders like Raphael), or treated her kids kindly — so she can be hostile, pragmatic, or willing to negotiate or return stolen items. This background explains why she both issues a countdown and moves to protect or disperse the children.

She clearly stole a piece from the set, fiddling with it as the player approaches.
